rows.en:
(I came to buy a late-night snack,
but I can't decide what to get...)
(Oh, this song is......)
Wow~, it's Sheryl's song~
Wait, Ranka?
rows.notes: Male. Surprised to find her there.

rows.en:
...If I became an idol someday too,
and my own songs played in places like this,
I'd be so happy~
Hehe... Just kidding.
I'm sure you can make it come true, Ranka.

Ehehe...
Thanks, \p-kun.

So, changing the subject,
what did you come to the convenience store
to buy, Ranka?

U-um...
Just something sweet......

Oh, I'd better get home!
See you, \p-kun.

(Ranka... If you're aiming to be an idol,
maybe you should cut back on the
late-night snacks...)

(I came to buy a late-night snack,
but I can't decide what to get...)
Wait, Ranka-chan?

I'm sure you can make it come true,
Ranka-chan.

Ehehe...
Thanks, \p-chan.

So, changing the subject,
what did you come to the convenience store
to buy, Ranka-chan?

Oh, I'd better get home!
See you, \p-chan.

(Ranka-chan... If you're aiming to be an idol,
maybe you should cut back on the
late-night snacks...)
(...Looks like there's been a lot of damage...)
rows.notes: Male. The city after an attack.

rows.en:
Who's that over there...?
Isn't that Ranka?!
What are you doing in a place like this...?

I was worried about the city,
so I came to see it...
What's going to happen to us, I wonder...
I don't know...

...There's no point staying here.
Let's go home, Ranka.
(...What's going to happen from now on...?)
(...Looks like there's been a lot of damage...)

Who's that over there...?
Isn't that Ranka-chan?!
\p-chan...
I don't know...

...There's no point staying here.
Let's go home, Ranka-chan.
(...What's going to happen to us...?)
You look totally wiped out.

Oh, Ranka...
The tests are finally over,
so I'm all worn out.
rows.notes: Male. ki ga nukeru = the tension has gone out of him.

rows.en: So how do you think you did?
So-so, I guess...
You have to study properly, you know?
...Not that I'm one to talk.

So hey, why don't we go somewhere
to take our minds off it?
Yeah, sounds good.
(Forget the tests, today I'm gonna have fun!)

Oh, Ranka-chan...
The tests are finally over,
so I'm all worn out.
So-so, I guess?
Yeah, sounds great!!
(Forget the tests, today I'm gonna have fun!)
(Lunchtime at last~! And who's that over there...)
Ranka, mind if I eat with you?
Hey, you can't leave your carrots.

But they don't taste good...
And they're rainbow-colored...
Really? I think they're tasty...

Then you can have them!
Eat lots!
...But they're sweet and tasty.

...Thanks for the meal.
Let's do our best this afternoon too!
(I guess Ranka doesn't like rainbow carrots.)
Ranka-chan, want to have lunch together?
Hey hey, you're leaving your carrots!
(Does Ranka-chan not like rainbow carrots?)
(I went to the wrong classroom...!)
rows.notes: PLAYER, both genders; hurrying, then bumps into Ranka.

rows.en: Eek!
rows.notes: Ranka here; also used by the player in scd_com_101.

rows.en: S-sorry, Ranka.

No, it was my fault for not looking
where I was going...
Yeah, thanks...
rows.notes: Ranka; answers an offer or question not shown in this scene (probably a choice).

rows.en:
I'm fine.
Being full of energy is the one thing
I've got going for me.
(...Ranka really is full of energy~)

Sorry, Ranka-chan.
Are you okay?
(...Ranka-chan really is full of energy~)
